post.originalText:
I asked AI to build a flying car you can drive, fly, sail and dive in a browser tab. 

19 hours of autonomous work later: 4 worlds, a real FFT ocean, scanned forests, coral reefs and whales.

Built with @claudeai Claude Code (Opus 5.5) + @threejs https://t.co/NCv9IHSCMh
